records.excerpt: Lambeth Council states that the local heritage list contains archaeology, buildings or structures, and spaces considered to have local or greater architectural or historic interest, and that the list is updated from time to time.

records.excerpt: Lambeth Council explains that Policy Q23 permits the council to keep a local heritage list of assets of local or greater significance, including buildings and structures, and that this local designation is separate from national listing.

records.record_scope: official policy basis, asset categories and interpretation boundary
